rationale: Three correctness defects found: isReset false-negative prevents filter clear when sort_order is at default 'desc', dual AssistantFilters interface duplication can drift, and optional type modifiers on sort_by/sort_order are incorrect since the merge useMemo always populates them.

follow_ups.title: isReset false-negative for sort_order='desc'
follow_ups.description: sort_order='desc' is a non-empty string so isReset evaluates false when the user clears all MARKETPLACE filters, leaving sort_order:'desc' persisted to storage and the clear-filters affordance permanently shown.

follow_ups.title: Dual AssistantFilters interface can drift
follow_ups.description: AssistantFilters.tsx defines its own local AssistantFilters interface independent of the exported one in useAssistantFilters.ts. Both were updated consistently in this diff but there is no compiler enforcement.

follow_ups.title: Optional modifiers on sort_by/sort_order are incorrect
follow_ups.description: useAssistantFilters.ts exports sort_by?: string | null and sort_order?: string but the merge useMemo always populates both from FILTER_INITIAL_STATE, forcing defensive ?? guards in the component.
